summary: findLastIndex searches from the end and returns the original index of the last item satisfying a predicate.
documentation: findLastIndex searches from the end and returns the original index of the last item satisfying a predicate. It returns -1 if nothing matches. Unlike lastIndexOf, the criterion can be a comparison rather than strict equality with a supplied value.
inputs: An object with readings (finite-number list) and limit (finite number).
caution: Index zero is a valid match and is falsey in a Boolean context. Do not reverse the array, because the result must refer to its original positions.
scenarios: Locate the last measurement at or above an alert threshold.
Find the latest queue item satisfying a readiness rule.
Identify a final qualifying row before resuming local processing.
title: Locate the last threshold reading
problem: Return the last index i where readings[i] >= limit. Return -1 when no reading qualifies. Inputs are finite numbers and order must remain unchanged.
hint: Use findLastIndex with a comparison callback.
goal: Use Array.findLastIndex() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
